fact: The Namibia Standards Institution leads the national standardisation strategy; its chief executive says it has published 235 standards since its establishment in 2008 and the national stock is 275, with a target of 1,267 within three years, but the article names no standard on information technology or data.

The Standards Act, 2005 (Act No. 18 of 2005), signed 23 December 2005 and gazetted 30 December 2005, establishes the Namibian Standards Institution as the national institution for the promotion, issue and maintenance of standards, with a governing Namibian Standards Council.

The Namibian Standards Institution (NSI) notice of 2026-06-15 states that four standards (chilled seafood, dates, laundry process management, refrigerating-appliance energy performance) were officially developed as NAMS, Namibian Standards, and are on sale through the NSI; the notice does not mention a law or decree setting up the body.
